caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a vintage bonnet or hat, presented in a side view. The bonnet consists of a series of overlapping, curved segments, each delineated by dark seam lines and shaded in muted green and brown tones, suggesting the presence of fabric folds and texture. The front of the bonnet is oval-shaped, bordered by darker green fabric, and the overall structure appears to be puffed or padded. At the base of the bonnet, there is an arrangement of gathered dark brown material, forming a bow or knot with two long, narrow ribbons trailing downward and off to the side. The background is light beige, with no additional objects or details present, focusing attention solely on the central headwear. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the artist's name.
title: Bonnet
